description: Source code for a fuzz testing class that tests color conversion functionality in the Android media stagefright library, including functions for calculating frame sizes and processing fuzzed input data.

classes.name: ColorConversionFuzzer
classes.description: A class that performs fuzz testing on color conversion routines using randomized input data.

methods.name: ColorConversionFuzzer::getFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of a color frame buffer based on format, stride, and height.
